description: REQ-008 step 2/step 6's multi-clip disambiguation algorithm computes new_hrefs PER CLIP as `stabilized_reels_set - set(that clip's OWN sidecar before-hrefs)` (behavioral-spec.md lines 188-198), confirming a clip ONLY when its own diff has EXACTLY ONE element. PROP-006(c) (verification-architecture.md line 79) is the worked example meant to prove this algorithm correctly disambiguates 2 simultaneous pending clips, but the example is either chronologically invalid or, taken literally, does not produce the claimed result: clip1(oldest) before=['/A/'], clip2(newer) before=['/B/'], stub reels=['/A/','/B/','/NEW1/','/NEW2/']. Since clip2 was moved to pending-verify AFTER clip1 (per the example's own 'clip1 moved BEFORE clip2 chronologically'), clip2's before-snapshot must have been captured later and therefore (posts don't disappear) should be a SUPERSET including /A/ -- before2={'/B/'} without /A/ is not a valid chronological instance of this algorithm. Even ignoring that and taking the numbers at face value: diff1 = reels_set - before1 = {'/B/','/NEW1/','/NEW2/'} = THREE elements, not 'exactly one' -- per REQ-008(6)'s own rule ('more than one element... treat as inconclusive, do NOT guess') clip1 must be classified INCONCLUSIVE, directly contradicting PROP-006(c)'s asserted outcome ('clip1 is attributed exactly one of /NEW1//NEW2/'). The spec's own algorithm, as literally written, cannot produce the behavior its own proof-obligation example claims to demonstrate. Root cause: the per-clip-own-sidecar diff has no mechanism to split 2 simultaneously-appearing new hrefs across 2 simultaneously-pending clips when neither clip's before-set already contains the other's real href -- a realistic scenario (both clips attempt-and-fail to verify in the same wake window, e.g. two consecutive posts to two different accounts within the ~few-minute self-heal cadence). In that realistic case, EVERY pending clip's own diff will contain ALL of the globs-batch new hrefs (>1 element) forever, so REQ-008(6)'s 'more than one -> inconclusive, retry next wake' rule never resolves for ANY of them on ANY future wake (the sidecars and the profile's href set do not change once both real posts exist), producing a PERMANENT STARVATION/livelock: both clips sit in $CLIP_PENDING_VERIFY indefinitely, never confirmed, never dropped -- which directly contradicts the spec's own stated invariant (Context section: 'never silently lose or duplicate a clip'; REQ-008(6): 'never silently drop it'). A clip that can never be confirmed nor explicitly failed is silently lost in effect, just not deleted from disk.

evidence.snippet: THE SELF-HEAL DRIVER SHALL compute new_hrefs = stabilized_reels_set - set(sidecar_hrefs) ... IF new_hrefs ... has EXACTLY ONE element for a given clip, THE SYSTEM SHALL treat it as now-confirmed ... IF new_hrefs is empty ... OR has more than one element (an ambiguous case ...) leave the clip in $CLIP_PENDING_VERIFY for the next wake
